issue.title: Lambda ESM metrics_config missing options
issue.body:
### Description

Lambda ESM metrics_config accepts more than just EventCount:
https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/blob/f4fd2723ed647078bced4bdf4b83e6a61c379546/service/lambda/types/enums.go#L147-L154

The version of the AWS SDK for Go should be updated to allow the new values to be used.

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

* `aws_lambda_event_source_mapping`

### Potential Terraform Configuration

Notice new values `ErrorCount` and `KafkaMetrics`:
```hcl
resource "aws_lambda_event_source_mapping" "test" {
  event_source_arn = aws_sqs_queue.test.arn
  function_name    = aws_lambda_function.test.arn

  metrics_config {
    metrics = ["EventCount", "ErrorCount", "KafkaMetrics"]
  }
}
```


### References

https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/01/aws-Lambda-observability-for-kafka-esm/:

> Similarly, customers can enable one or more metrics groups—EventCount, ErrorCount, and KafkaMetrics—to monitor various aspects of event processing. 

### Would you like to implement the enhancement?

Yes
